file.content:
composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Honour an optional 'Idempotency-Key' header first: a repeat with an already-seen key
# replays the original owner (200) instead of re-running the create pipeline.
idempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotencyKey
  outputs:
    create: validate
    replay: replay

replay:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ReplayCreatedOwner
  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RequireOwnerFields
  next: rejectFutureRegistrationDate

rejectFutureRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RejectFutureRegistrationDate
  next: validatePostcode

validatePostcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidatePostcode
  next: normalizeTelephone

normalizeTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerTelephone
  next: validateTelephoneCountryLength

validateTelephoneCountryLength:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateTelephoneCountryLength
  next: normalizeEmail

normalizeEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerEmail
  next: rejectDisposableEmailDomain

rejectDisposableEmailDomain:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RejectDisposableEmailDomain
  next: rejectCityAtCapacity

rejectCityAtCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RejectCityAtCapacity
  next: rejectDailyLimit

rejectDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RejectDailyLimit
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignCustomerCode

assignCustomerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: rejectDuplicateIdentity

rejectDuplicateIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RejectDuplicateIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignPossibleDuplicate

assignPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdSize

assignHouseholdSize:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdSize
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMembershipLevel

assignMembershipLevel:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: record

record:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotencyKey
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

2185:            locality:

2193:              description: The owner's IANA timezone derived from the locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region yields no known timezone.
2197:            ownerSegment:
2199:              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.

I've prepared the code for the upcoming `memberId` unification without implementing the change itself.

## What I did

The upcoming change unifies `customerCode` + `membershipNumber` into a single `memberId` formatted `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`. Implemented naively, the hotspot classes bloat because **the identity-code format is currently known in several places at once**: `OwnerCustomerCode.of` composes it, but `OwnerMapper.toLocality` re-parses it (`indexOf('-')`) and `OwnerMapper.toCheckDigit` re-implements the Luhn loop inline — unlike the codebase's other derived fields, which all delegate to a focused utility (`toIdentityKey`→`OwnerIdentity`, `toFiscalYear`→`FiscalYear`, `toTelephoneDisplay`→`E164Telephone`).

I consolidated the format knowledge into `OwnerCustomerCode` (the class that will naturally become `MemberId`), so it now owns the whole format — compose, decompose, and check:

- **`OwnerCustomerCode.regionOf(code)`** — reads the REGION segment back out of a code (inverse of `of`).
- **`OwnerCustomerCode.luhn(s)`** — the check-digit algorithm, moved out of the mapper.
- **`OwnerMapper.toLocality`** and **`toCheckDigit`** are now thin delegators, matching the surrounding style.

This directly relieves the named mapper hotspot (`toLocality`) and pre-positions two of the named future methods (`MemberId::luhn`, `MemberId::regionOf`) in the right place, so the change becomes a localized edit to one format-owning class rather than scattered edits across the mapper. `ValidatePostcode` already shares `OwnerCustomerCode`'s region reference data (so it needs only an import swap later), and `AuditOwnerCreated` already carries an explicit `primaryIdentifier` seam — I left both as-is.

## Verification

## One thing to flag

The repository's **only** concrete test, `AcceptanceTest.coreReturnsUnifiedMemberId`, is the acceptance test *for the change itself* — it asserts `memberId` exists and that `customerCode`/`membershipNumber` are removed. I therefore treated it as the change's target (red by design) rather than making it green by building the feature.
